$schema_note: Vectors for the L1 duration resolver (computeBillableDays) — the pipeline stage that OWNS the off-rent clock, grace, and minimum-period rules (blueprint §2.2 invariant 4). APPEND-ONLY with stable ids. billable days = max(minimum_days, max(1, ceil((clock_end - start - grace_hours) / 24h))). clock_end_at is off_rent_at when the clock was stopped — return/pickup timing never extends billing.

cases.description: 3 days + 1 hour with no grace ceilings to 4 billable days.
Same 3d1h span with a 2-hour grace policy bills 3 days.
Off-rent stamped 9 days in stops billing there — the unit sitting in the field awaiting pickup is not billable (clock_end_at IS off_rent_at).
A 6-hour rental under a 3-day contractual minimum bills 3 days.
